title: docs: TypeScript legacy node10 resolution is unsupported for the 15 packages with subpath exports
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi941YjangeAFXEgevqVv4bY9)_
Fixes #26208
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：插件开发指南加一段「Module resolution」，15 个带子路径 exports 的已发布包 README 各加一行：TypeScript 老的 node10 解析不支持，请用 node16、nodenext 或 bundler。
- 为什么改：按裁决 A（6422810199）落地。node10 不读 exports，用这种配置的使用方 import 子路径时类型静默找不到。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档和 README，不动 exports、不加 typesVersions、不加门禁。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：content/docs/plugins/development.mdx（新段落），packages/spec/README.md（README 行的样子），.changeset/26208-node10-resolution-unsupported.md。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:published-readme-links`，预期 0 root-relative、锚点全部解析（含新的 #module-resolution）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `content/docs/plugins/development.mdx`: a `### Module resolution` paragraph right under the Step 1 `tsconfig.json` block (the page already shows `moduleResolution: "bundler"`). It states that the published packages declare entry points only through `exports`, that `node10` (`"node"`, the default under `module: commonjs`) ignores `exports` and is unsupported, and that `bundler`, `node16` or `nodenext` is required. Chosen over `content/docs/getting-started/**`: no page there covers TypeScript setup, and open work holds that tree (the seat-3 hand-over 6430890935 names the collisions).
- One identical line in the README of each of the 15 packages, linking to that anchor. Placed before the first `##` heading (after the intro), appended at the end for the three READMEs that have no `##` heading (platform-objects, plugin-webhooks, service-cluster), and under the existing "TypeScript Configuration" section in `packages/types/README.md`.
- Root changeset: one `patch` for the 15 packages, because each README is in its package's `files[]` and ships in the tarball.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-read on `origin/main` 6390fe52: every one of the 15 packages still has subpath `exports` (spec 19, platform-objects 10, metadata 5, cli 2, lint 2, plugin-auth 2, the other nine 1 each), and no `packages/**/package.json` declares `typesVersions` (0 files). After #26321 and #26352, metadata-core, service-cluster and cli still carry subpaths, so none was dropped from the list.
- A scan of every non-private `packages/**/package.json` finds exactly these 15 published packages with subpath exports, so the list is complete on this tree.
- Evidence for the claim: the attw 0.18.5 `NoResolution@node10` reading on PR #26198 (os-dev report 6419735271).
- Out of scope, untouched: no `exports` or `typesVersions` change, no new check, no `ui/` path.

## Verification

At head 894bdb38.

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` printed: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 92 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`

Two families first exited on shallow-clone prerequisites (`check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` exit 2, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3); after deepening the clone both exit 0. The build-reading families (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, spec `check:docs`, `check:skill-examples`) ran after a locked `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (VERDICT command-exit 0) and exit 0.
</details>

- `pnpm check:published-readme-links` exit 0: `567 outbound link(s) across 159 published markdown file(s): 0 root-relative, 0 non-canonical origin(s), 62 docs-site page(s) resolved (0 via redirect), 17 anchor(s) verified`.
- `pnpm check:published-readme-exports` exit 0 (run on the built tree; outside the derivation, run because the card names it).
- `pnpm check:doc-anchors` exit 0: 598 internal fragment links all resolve.
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exit 0.
- lychee (`check-links.yml`) not run locally; the docs paragraph adds no outbound link. Read from this PR's check-runs.
</details>
